# Cedar Park Health — Portfolio Company (Healthcare Services)

> Not to be confused with the pipeline deal
> [Cedar Point Logistics](cedar-point-logistics.md) — similar name, different company, and SCP
> does **not** own Cedar Point.

- **What it is:** a multi-site outpatient healthcare-services network; SCP acquired it in 2021.
- **Metrics:** ~**$28M EBITDA**; current gross **MOIC 3.2x**, gross IRR ~41% — the fund's best
  performer.
- **Board:** [Kate Sinclair](../profile/principal.md) sits on the board.
- **CEO:** Susan Alvarado (operator hired post-close).
- **Status:** **performing; hold.** No exit planned near-term; continuing de-novo site expansion.
